title: Your company's house style
lead: Start from the example house style, change anything and save it as a new house style. Reports from every OpenAEC tool on this computer then use it.
desktopOnly: The house style maker works in the desktop app.

list.title: House styles
list.none: No house style of your own yet. Change the example and save it.
list.activeDefault: All OpenAEC tools now use the OpenAEC house style.

state.savedActive: Saved in {{dir}}. All OpenAEC tools now use this house style.
state.inUse: All OpenAEC tools now use this house style.

hints.brand: The name and tagline of the company, as they appear on the cover.
hints.colors: Each colour has a name the rest of the house style refers to. Click the swatch or type a code such as #1F6F43.
hints.fonts: Which font for headings, body text and numbers. The name must be listed under Font files.
hints.font_files: The file (.ttf or .otf) for each font. Choose a file; it is copied into the house style folder when you save.
hints.logos: The logos: main for the cover, light for a light background. PNG or SVG.
hints.contact: The company details for the colophon and the back cover.
hints.gradient: The colours of the accent strip.
hints.header: The header of every page: height in millimetres and the lines, texts and images in it.
hints.styles: Font, size and colour of headings and body text.
hints.pages: The layout of the cover, colophon, table of contents and back cover.
hints.stationery: A PDF or image as the background for each kind of page.
hints.modules: The colours of tables, calculations and checks.
hints.yaml: The whole file as it will be saved. You can also edit it here directly; then click Apply.
hints.files: What is in the house style folder. Files you choose are added when you save.

preview.title: Preview
preview.note: A sketch with the colours, fonts and logo. You see the real layout in a report from a tool.
preview.heading: 1 Starting points
preview.body: This report describes the structural starting points of the project. The calculations follow the Eurocode with the Dutch annexes.

saveAs.title: Save as new house style
saveAs.name: Company name
saveAs.exampleName: This is still the name of the example. Enter the name of your company.
saveAs.own: With my house styles on this computer
saveAs.other: In another folder, for instance on the company drive
saveAs.activate: Use it in all OpenAEC tools right away

discard.title: Discard changes?
discard.text: The house style you are editing has changes that are not saved.
